scope: CAS-16-C03 finite scalar product quadrature only
authority: Published CAS-16 C03 component plus standard explicit realization of the named GL5 and equally spaced azimuth rules; owner instruction to continue the remaining proof DAG.

coordinates.normalization: Q[f]=(1/2) sum_r w_r (1/9) sum_{j=0}^8 f(mu_r,2*pi*j/9); exact target is (1/(4*pi)) integral_S2 f dOmega

gauss_legendre_5.branch: all square roots are nonnegative real roots

monomial_family: x^a y^b z^c for natural a,b,c with a+b+c <= 8
exact_target: For every monomial in the family, Q[x^a y^b z^c]=(1/(4*pi)) integral_S2 x^a y^b z^c dOmega.

underresolution_controls.radial_GL4: For the standard 4-point Gauss-Legendre rule, Q_GL4[mu^8]-integral_{-1}^1 mu^8 dmu = -128/11025, hence nonzero.
underresolution_controls.azimuth_Nphi8: For phi_j=2*pi*j/8, (1/8)sum cos(phi_j)^8 - (1/(2*pi))integral_0^{2*pi} cos(phi)^8 dphi = 1/128, hence nonzero.

domains_units_signs.orientation: standard right-handed Cartesian sphere chart; scalar monomials only

dependency_binding.reason: This finite scalar product-grid certificate uses only the explicitly named quadrature rule and sphere chart. Parent CAS-15 dependency remains open for collision/weak-integrand claims.

excluded: general Gauss-Legendre or Fourier exactness theorem
historical CAS-16 scripts/results as proof inputs
